text: Replaces the default "openclaw." prefix on OpenClaw-owned metric names. Use an empty string to remove the prefix, or up to 128 ASCII letters, digits, underscores, dots, hyphens, and slashes starting with a letter. Include any separator you need, for example "acme."; standard gen_ai.* metric names are unchanged. Changing this value requires updating dashboards and alerts that query the old names.
translated: 取代 OpenClaw 自有指標名稱的預設 "openclaw." 前綴。使用空字串可移除前綴，或使用以字母開頭、最多 128 個 ASCII 字母、數字、底線、句點、連字號與斜線組成的字串。請包含所需的分隔符號，例如 "acme."；標準 gen_ai.* 指標名稱不受影響。變更此值後，必須更新查詢舊名稱的儀表板與警示。

text: This portal uses HTTP with a different hostname or scheme from the Control UI. Open the link in a new tab so its authentication cookies work, or use an HTTPS portal for an embedded preview.
translated: 此入口網站使用 HTTP，且主機名稱或通訊協定配置與 Control UI 不同。請在新分頁中開啟連結，讓其驗證 Cookie 正常運作，或使用 HTTPS 入口網站來顯示嵌入式預覽。
OpenTelemetry 緩衝區排送間隔（毫秒）

text: Plugin ID required to admit worker repository source access, including native, GitHub App, and managed OAuth or PAT credentials. Missing, disabled or unloaded owners deny admission. Omit to use native repository behavior; enabling a plugin alone does not select it.
translated: 允許工作程序存取儲存庫來源所需的外掛程式 ID，涵蓋原生、GitHub App，以及受管理的 OAuth 或 PAT 憑證。若所屬外掛程式不存在、已停用或未載入，則會拒絕存取。省略此設定可使用原生儲存庫行為；僅啟用外掛程式並不會將其選定。

text: Enable or disable apply_patch for OpenAI and OpenAI Codex models when allowed by tool policy (default: true).
translated: 在工具政策允許時，為 OpenAI 和 OpenAI Codex 模型啟用或停用 apply_patch（預設：true）。

text: Controls where approval prompts are sent: "session" uses origin chat, "targets" uses configured targets, and "both" sends to both paths. Use "session" as baseline and expand only when operational workflow requires redundancy.
translated: 控制核准提示的傳送位置："session" 使用來源聊天，"targets" 使用已設定的目標，"both" 則同時傳送至兩者。請以 "session" 為基本設定，僅在維運工作流程需要備援通知時擴大傳送範圍。

text: Select a session you can access or change sharing for this session.
translated: 請選擇您有權存取的工作階段，或變更此工作階段的分享設定。

text: Couldn’t use this device or workspace. Refresh and try again.
translated: 無法使用此裝置或工作區。請重新整理後再試一次。

text: Couldn’t confirm your decision. Refresh to check its status before trying again.
translated: 無法確認您的決定。請重新整理以確認狀態，再重試。
無法變更權限。請再試一次。

text: Per-hook timeout overrides in milliseconds keyed by typed hook name, capped at 600000. Use narrow overrides for known slow hooks such as before_prompt_build or agent_end instead of raising every hook timeout.
translated: 各掛鉤的逾時覆寫設定，以具型別掛鉤名稱為索引鍵，單位為毫秒，上限為 600000。對於 before_prompt_build 或 agent_end 等已知執行緩慢的掛鉤，請針對個別掛鉤覆寫設定，而非提高所有掛鉤的逾時時間。

text: Couldn’t open this session. Try again.
translated: 無法開啟此工作階段。請再試一次。

text: Couldn’t refresh update status. Check your connection and try again.
translated: 無法重新整理更新狀態。請檢查連線後再試一次。

無法載入用量。請再試一次。

{error}

text: Step details are not available yet.
translated: 步驟詳細資訊尚未可用。

text: Click Connect again after updating the Gateway secret.
translated: 更新 Gateway 密鑰後，再次點擊「連線」。

text: Maximum serialized bytes returned through code-mode output.
translated: 透過程式碼模式輸出傳回的序列化資料位元組數上限。

text: Maximum image pixel count accepted by the provider for this model.
translated: 供應商針對此模型接受的圖片像素數上限。

text: Shows catalog-backed CLI agents in the Control UI new-session model picker when true (default: true). Set false to disable CLI agents and native CLI session creation. Only catalogs that advertise session creation are listed, and the picker stays hidden when the Gateway does not advertise session catalog support.
translated: 設為 true 時，會在 Control UI 新工作階段的模型選擇器中顯示目錄提供的 CLI 代理程式（預設：true）。設為 false 可停用 CLI 代理程式及原生 CLI 工作階段建立功能。只會列出宣告支援建立工作階段的目錄；若 Gateway 未宣告支援工作階段目錄，選擇器會保持隱藏。

text: Controls how long completed automation run sessions are kept before pruning (`24h`, `7d`, `1h30m`, or `false` to disable pruning; a zero duration such as `0h` also disables; default: `24h`). Use shorter retention to reduce storage growth on high-frequency schedules.
translated: 控制已完成的自動化執行工作階段在清除前的保留時間（`24h`、`7d`、`1h30m`，或設為 `false` 以停用清除；零時長如 `0h` 也會停用清除；預設值：`24h`）。對於高頻率排程，可縮短保留時間以減少儲存空間的增長。

text: Per-plugin typed hook policy controls for core-enforced safety gates. Use this to constrain high-impact hook categories without disabling the entire plugin.
translated: 個別外掛程式的具型別掛鉤原則控制項，用於核心強制執行的安全檢查。可用於限制影響較大的掛鉤類別，而無須停用整個外掛程式。
搜尋工作階段對話記錄

text: This plugin action is currently unavailable. Reopen the session menu.
translated: 此外掛程式動作目前無法使用。請重新開啟工作階段選單。

text: Optional initial prompt for the native CLI
translated: 原生 CLI 的初始提示詞 (選填)

text: Allow enabled user-installed plugins to execute native JavaScript in the Control UI (default: true). Retained as an advanced config-only opt-out; existing false values remain off. Bundled plugin views are unaffected. Native UI shares the signed-in operator's Gateway permissions; install only trusted plugins. Changes apply without a Gateway restart. After disabling, reload open Control UI pages to clear previously loaded plugin code.
translated: 允許已啟用且由使用者安裝的外掛程式在 Control UI 中執行原生 JavaScript（預設值：true）。此選項保留為僅能透過設定停用的進階選項；現有值為 false 時會維持停用。隨附的外掛程式檢視不受影響。原生 UI 共用已登入操作人員的 Gateway 權限；請只安裝受信任的外掛程式。變更無須重新啟動 Gateway 即可生效。停用後，請重新載入已開啟的 Control UI 頁面，以清除先前載入的外掛程式碼。
操作人員終端機命令殼層

text: Talk ended because the Gateway has not acknowledged microphone audio for 30 seconds. Check the connection and start Talk again.
translated: 語音對話已結束，因為 Gateway 已有 30 秒未確認收到麥克風音訊。請檢查連線，然後重新開始語音對話。

text: Download started. Check your browser downloads.
translated: 已開始下載。請查看瀏覽器的下載項目。

text: This browser cannot capture dictation audio at 8 kHz.
translated: 此瀏覽器無法以 8 kHz 擷取聽寫音訊。

text: Cameras are unavailable while this page is inactive.
translated: 此頁面未啟用時, 無法使用攝影機。

text: Agent Sandbox Docker Allow Container Namespace Join
translated: 代理程式沙箱 Docker 允許加入容器命名空間

text: Automations Webhook Allow IPv6 Unique Local Range
translated: 自動化 Webhook 允許 IPv6 唯一本地位址範圍

text: {count} compressed archives moved from the database to files.
translated: 已將 {count} 筆壓縮封存從資料庫移至檔案。

text: Per-profile browser executable path for locally launched managed browser profiles. Overrides browser.executablePath and accepts paths starting with ~ for the OS home directory.
translated: 各設定檔的瀏覽器執行檔路徑，適用於在本機啟動的受管理瀏覽器設定檔。此設定會覆寫 browser.executablePath，並接受以 ~ 開頭的路徑，以表示作業系統的使用者主目錄。

text: Condition triggers are disabled by cron.triggers.enabled.
translated: 條件觸發器已由 cron.triggers.enabled 停用。
無法確認裝置是否已連線

text: Web-tool policy grouping for search/fetch providers, limits, and fallback behavior tuning. Keep enabled settings aligned with API key availability and outbound networking policy.
translated: 網頁工具的原則設定群組，用於調整搜尋／擷取供應商、限制與備援行為。啟用設定應與 API 金鑰可用性及對外網路連線原則保持一致。

text: Another dashboard change is still being saved.
translated: 另一項儀表板變更仍在儲存中。
模型供應商本機服務命令

text: Gateway-local PNG, JPEG, WebP, or GIF path. Relative paths resolve from the directory containing the active configuration file; ~/ expands to the Gateway user's home directory. Only this configured image is exposed through the scoped provider asset route.
translated: Gateway 本機上的 PNG、JPEG、WebP 或 GIF 路徑。相對路徑以目前使用的設定檔所在目錄為基準解析；~/ 會展開為 Gateway 使用者的家目錄。僅此設定指定的圖片會透過限定範圍的供應商資源路由對外提供。
Gateway 節點配對 SSH 驗證

text: macOS may be using a stale permission grant. Open System Settings to review it.
translated: macOS 可能正在使用過期的權限授予記錄。請開啟「系統設定」進行檢查。

text: OpenClaw version used by the last wizard run.
translated: 上次執行精靈時使用的 OpenClaw 版本。

text: Couldn’t access your saved messages. Reload to try again. Do not clear browser site data if you want to keep them.
translated: 無法存取您儲存的訊息。請重新載入以再試一次。如果您想保留這些訊息，請勿清除瀏覽器網站資料。

text: Couldn’t refresh this session. Reload to see the saved permissions.
translated: 無法重新整理此工作階段。請重新載入以查看已儲存的權限。

text: Usage grouped by who started each session, not by who sent each message.
translated: 用量依各工作階段的發起者分組，而非依各則訊息的傳送者分組。

text: Gateway-wide cap on unassigned prepared cloud workers across projects and profiles (default: 4). Preparing workers and unconfirmed reserve cleanup count toward the cap. Set 0 to drain unassigned reserves and disable replenishment while preserving snapshot reuse and active sessions.
translated: Gateway 全域中，跨專案與設定檔的未指派預備雲端工作節點數量上限（預設：4）。準備中的工作節點與尚未確認清理完成的備用節點均計入此上限。設為 0 可清空未指派的備用節點並停用補充，同時保留快照重用功能與進行中的工作階段。

text: Desktop access isn’t available on this device.
translated: 此裝置無法使用桌面存取功能。

text: Used for this agent’s commands and dashboard data. Verified confirms the account; repository access is checked when data is requested.
translated: 用於此代理程式的命令及儀表板資料。「已驗證」表示帳號已確認；儲存庫存取權會在請求資料時檢查。

text: Choose how OpenClaw looks in this browser. Preferences stay here unless noted.
translated: 選擇 OpenClaw 在此瀏覽器中的外觀。除非另有註明，偏好設定僅儲存於此瀏覽器。

text: Dream cache repair finished with no changes.
translated: 夢境快取修復已完成，未做任何變更。

text: Echo the audio transcript to the originating chat before agent processing. Enable this when users need to verify what the system heard.
translated: 在代理處理前，將音訊轉錄文字回傳至來源聊天。當使用者需要確認系統聽到的內容時，請啟用此功能。

text: Check that the endpoint provides a compatible model, then try again.
translated: 請確認端點提供相容的模型，再試一次。

text: Filesystem path to the TLS certificate file used by the gateway when TLS is enabled. Use managed certificate paths and keep renewal automation aligned with this location.
translated: 啟用 TLS 時，Gateway 所使用的 TLS 憑證檔案在檔案系統中的路徑。請使用受管理的憑證路徑，並確保自動續期作業使用相同位置。

text: Couldn’t load device capacity. Try again.
translated: 無法載入裝置容量。請再試一次。

text: External relay settings for relay-backed APNs sends. The gateway uses the hosted OpenClaw relay by default, or this custom relay for push.test, wake nudges, and reconnect wakes after a paired official iOS build publishes a relay-backed registration.
translated: 透過轉送服務傳送 APNs 通知的外部轉送設定。在已配對的官方 iOS 版本發布透過轉送服務的註冊資訊後，Gateway 預設會使用託管的 OpenClaw 轉送服務，或使用此自訂轉送服務來執行 push.test、喚醒提醒及重新連線喚醒。

text: Runs through the {runtime} agent runtime and the account it uses.
translated: 透過 {runtime} 代理程式執行環境及其使用的帳戶執行。

text: ACP session mode override for this binding (persistent or oneshot).
translated: 覆寫此綁定的 ACP 工作階段模式（persistent 或 oneshot）。

text: Prepares unassigned cloud devices per eligible project after a successful session. Leave empty for one; zero disables reserves. Ready devices incur running-device charges.
translated: 工作階段成功完成後，為每個符合資格的專案準備未指派的雲端裝置。留空則準備一台；設為零則停用備用裝置。就緒裝置會產生裝置運行費用。
網頁擷取封鎖的主機名稱

text: Summaries are generated about every 5 minutes when new speech is captured. Follow the Transcript tab for speech as it is saved.
translated: 擷取到新的語音時，約每 5 分鐘產生一次摘要。請前往「逐字稿」分頁查看陸續儲存的語音內容。

text: Native Codex search context size hint: "low", "medium", or "high".
translated: 原生 Codex 搜尋的上下文大小提示："low"、"medium" 或 "high"。

text: Optional session-key filters matched as substring or regex-style patterns, for example `["discord:", "^agent:ops:"]`. Use narrow patterns so only intended approval contexts are forwarded to shared destinations.
translated: 選用的工作階段鍵篩選條件，以子字串或類似正規表示式的模式進行比對，例如 `["discord:", "^agent:ops:"]`。請使用範圍較窄的模式，確保只有預期的核准情境會轉送至共用目的地。

text: Ask the agent to start an app in a portal.
translated: 請要求代理程式在入口中啟動應用程式。

text: Couldn’t create a new session. Try again.
translated: 無法建立新的工作階段。請再試一次。

text: Discord account linking isn’t configured. Ask an admin to enable it.
translated: 尚未設定 Discord 帳號連結功能。請洽管理員啟用。

text: Runs the Gateway as a background service so channels and automations keep working after you quit OpenClaw.
translated: 將 Gateway 作為背景服務執行，讓頻道和自動化功能在您結束 OpenClaw 後仍能繼續運作。

text: Backward-readable compatibility metadata retained so older binaries can refuse unsafe config downgrades.
translated: 保留可供舊版讀取的相容性中繼資料，讓舊版執行檔能拒絕不安全的設定降級。

text: Watch and control cloud device desktops from Crabbox AWS, Azure, or Hetzner profiles with desktop support enabled.
translated: 查看並控制使用 Crabbox AWS、Azure 或 Hetzner 設定檔且已啟用桌面支援的雲端裝置桌面。

text: Couldn’t save the recovery request. Free browser storage and try again. Your goal update wasn’t sent.
translated: 無法儲存復原請求。請釋出瀏覽器儲存空間並重試。你的目標更新尚未送出。

text: Optional thread/topic target for channels that support threaded delivery of forwarded plugin approvals.
translated: 選用的討論串／主題目標，適用於支援以討論串方式傳送轉送之外掛程式核准的頻道。

text: {runtime} can’t enforce this session’s OpenClaw workspace-only restriction.
translated: {runtime} 無法強制遵守此工作階段僅限 OpenClaw 工作區的限制。

text: Find sessions on this Gateway and paired devices. Enable the {plugin} plugin to use it.
translated: 尋找此 Gateway 和已配對裝置上的工作階段。啟用 {plugin} 外掛程式即可使用。

text: GitHub-backed sign-in through Cloudflare Access or Tailscale Serve provides this identity.
translated: 此身分由透過 Cloudflare Access 或 Tailscale Serve 的 GitHub 登入提供。
在 OpenClaw 外部開啟連結

text: The run is known, but this execution path did not retain a supported identity context.
translated: 已知此執行存在，但此執行路徑未保留受支援的身分情境。

text: No new trusted session candidates were found.
translated: 找不到新的可信任工作階段候選項目。
內嵌式 OpenClaw 專案設定政策

text: Drag to set your preferred account order.
translated: 拖曳以設定您偏好的帳號順序。

text: No active sessions match this filter
translated: 沒有符合此篩選條件的進行中工作階段

text: Couldn’t build the snapshot. Choose a local Git checkout with a commit.
translated: 無法建置快照。請選擇包含提交紀錄的本機 Git 工作副本。

text: Uses the provider’s API connection with OpenClaw’s runtime. API usage is billed to that provider account.
translated: 透過 OpenClaw 的執行環境使用供應商的 API 連線。API 用量會向該供應商帳戶計費。

text: This Gateway does not support this session action.
translated: 此 Gateway 不支援這項工作階段操作。
適用於所有模型的工具搜尋

text: Choose Set up Chrome on this device to prepare Chrome for OpenClaw.
translated: 選擇「在此裝置上設定 Chrome」，讓 Chrome 準備好供 OpenClaw 使用。
刪除工作階段前先確認

text: Sign in with a Gateway profile to create personal skills.
translated: 使用 Gateway 設定檔登入，以建立個人技能。

text: Couldn’t secure the desktop connection. Reconnect to try again. {reason}
translated: 無法確保桌面連線安全。請重新連線以再試一次。{reason}

text: DANGEROUS toggle that allows hosted embeds to load absolute external http(s) URLs. Keep this off unless your Control UI intentionally embeds trusted third-party pages; hosted /__openclaw__/canvas documents do not need it.
translated: 危險開關，允許託管的嵌入內容載入外部 http(s) 絕對 URL。除非您的 Control UI 有意嵌入受信任的第三方頁面，否則請保持關閉；託管的 /__openclaw__/canvas 文件不需要此設定。

text: Couldn’t paste. Reconnect to a managed browser and try again.
translated: 無法貼上。請重新連線至受管理的瀏覽器後再試一次。
停止裝置上的工作階段…
瀏覽器設定檔 Chrome MCP 命令
已使用 {used} 個工作階段名額，共 {total} 個

text: Transcript source provider id, such as a Discord voice or future Slack huddle provider. Use the exact id exposed by the provider plugin.
translated: 逐字稿來源提供者的 ID，例如 Discord 語音或未來的 Slack 小組通話提供者。請使用提供者外掛程式所提供的確切 ID。

text: Shares enabled channel and provider names, plugin count, and recent session count with the daily update check. Disabled by default and always disabled when DO_NOT_TRACK=1.
translated: 在每日更新檢查時分享已啟用的頻道與供應商名稱、外掛數量及近期工作階段數量。預設為停用，且在 DO_NOT_TRACK=1 時一律停用。

text: Archives inactive dashboard sessions after this duration (for example `7d`) so they remain available without crowding the active session list. Set `false` or `0` to disable automatic dashboard archiving.
translated: 在儀表板工作階段閒置達指定時間後（例如 `7d`）將其封存，使其仍可存取，又不會擠滿使用中的工作階段清單。設為 `false` 或 `0` 可停用儀表板自動封存。

text: Maximum time in milliseconds allowed for shell environment resolution before fallback behavior applies. Use tighter timeouts for faster startup, or increase when shell initialization is heavy.
translated: 解析 Shell 環境所允許的最長時間，以毫秒為單位；超過此時間後會採用後備行為。縮短逾時時間可加快啟動速度；若 Shell 初始化作業較繁重，則可延長。

text: Artwork source: file for a Gateway-local image, url for a public HTTPS image, or builtin for an icon bundled with the Control UI.
translated: 圖片來源：file 表示 Gateway 本機圖片，url 表示公開的 HTTPS 圖片，builtin 表示 Control UI 內建圖示。
此摘要產生後有新活動

text: Optional absolute path to the Crabbox executable on the gateway.
translated: 選填的 Gateway 上 Crabbox 執行檔絕對路徑。

text: This session’s device setup was interrupted. Check recent sessions before starting this task again.
translated: 此工作階段的裝置設定已中斷。再次啟動此任務前，請先查看最近的工作階段。
模型供應商託管服務監控計時

text: Optional condition checks, delivery guarantees, schedule jitter, and model controls.
translated: 可選的條件檢查、傳送保證、排程抖動及模型控制。

text: This snapshot is still allocated and can’t be deleted yet.
translated: 此快照仍在配置使用中，目前無法刪除。

text: Allow Plugin LLM Auth Profile Override
translated: 允許外掛程式覆寫 LLM 驗證設定檔

text: Optional shell command run before OpenClaw is installed; it must be safe to repeat.
translated: 在安裝 OpenClaw 前執行的選用 shell 指令；必須能安全地重複執行。

text: Native Codex web search preference: "cached" (default; unrestricted Codex turns resolve it to live) or "live".
translated: 原生 Codex 網頁搜尋偏好設定："cached"（預設值；不受限制的 Codex 回合會將其解析為 live）或 "live"。

text: Controls provider catalog behavior: "merge" keeps built-ins and overlays your custom providers, while "replace" uses only your configured providers. In "merge", matching provider IDs preserve non-empty agent models.json baseUrl values, while apiKey values are preserved only when the provider is not SecretRef-managed in current config/auth-profile context; SecretRef-managed providers refresh apiKey from current source markers, and matching model contextWindow/maxTokens use the higher value between explicit and implicit entries.

text: Per-provider tool allow/deny overrides keyed by channel/provider ID to tailor capabilities by surface. text: Thinking level used only for embedded OpenClaw compaction summaries: "off", "minimal", "low", "medium", "high", "xhigh", "adaptive", "max", "ultra", or "inherit". Explicit settings override provider defaults, and the selected level is clamped to the actual compaction model/runtime. Native Codex app-server compaction ignores this setting because its compact request has no per-operation thinking override, and OpenClaw logs a warning.
translated: 僅用於內嵌 OpenClaw 壓縮摘要的思考等級："off"、"minimal"、"low"、"medium"、"high"、"xhigh"、"adaptive"、"max"、"ultra" 或 "inherit"。預設採用供應商的壓縮偏好設定，否則使用 "low"；原生本機 Ollama 偏好 "off"。設為 "inherit" 可沿用工作階段的等級。明確指定的設定會覆寫供應商預設值，且所選等級會限制在實際壓縮模型／執行環境支援的範圍內。原生 Codex app-server 壓縮會忽略此設定，因為其壓縮請求不支援針對個別作業覆寫思考等級，OpenClaw 也會記錄警告。

text: Extra request headers sent with direct web_fetch requests, for example gateway routing or authentication headers. Every configured value is treated as sensitive and redacted from exposed config and debug captures. Values are plain strings, support ${VAR} substitution and the global $${VAR} literal escape, and are sent to model-chosen URLs. Entries are validated when the request is built rather than at config load, so a bad name or unsendable value is dropped and logged instead of disabling the surface; Accept, Accept-Language, User-Agent, and framing headers such as Transfer-Encoding are dropped too. Use tools.web.fetch.userAgent to change the user agent. Cross-origin redirects retain only the guarded-fetch safe header allowlist, and changing the headers actually sent partitions the fetch cache.
translated: 隨直接 web_fetch 請求傳送的額外請求標頭，例如閘道路由或驗證標頭。所有設定值皆視為敏感資訊，並會在對外顯示的設定和偵錯擷取資料中遮蔽。值為純字串，支援 ${VAR} 替換及全域 $${VAR} 字面值跳脫，且會傳送至模型選擇的 URL。項目會在建立請求時驗證，而非在載入設定時驗證，因此無效的名稱或無法傳送的值會被捨棄並記錄，而不會停用此功能；Accept、Accept-Language、User-Agent，以及 Transfer-Encoding 等訊息框架標頭也會被捨棄。若要變更使用者代理，請使用 tools.web.fetch.userAgent。跨來源重新導向僅會保留 guarded-fetch 安全標頭允許清單中的標頭，而變更實際傳送的標頭會使擷取快取分開儲存。

text: Maximum number of queued inbound items retained before drop policy applies. Default is 20; keep caps bounded in noisy channels so memory usage remains predictable.
translated: 套用捨棄策略前，佇列中可保留的傳入項目數量上限。預設為 20；對訊息繁多的頻道，請設定適當上限，讓記憶體用量維持在可預期的範圍內。

text: This side chat model can’t read images. Choose a model that supports images, then try again.
translated: 此側邊聊天模型無法讀取圖片。請選擇支援圖片的模型，然後再試一次。

text: This live view includes conversation text, tool steps, shared images, and interactive widgets. Tool result text and reasoning are omitted.
translated: 此即時檢視包含對話文字、工具步驟、分享的圖片及互動式小工具。不包含工具結果文字及推理內容。

text: Allow the agent to show and control the Canvas panel.
translated: 允許代理程式顯示及控制 Canvas 面板。

text: Unsaved raw config edits — save or discard them before switching to Form.
translated: 有未儲存的原始設定編輯內容 — 請先儲存或捨棄，再切換至表單。

text: One useful foreign phrase with your morning coffee.
translated: 用一句實用外語，搭配你的晨間咖啡。

text: The current browser navigation rules block this address. Select another tab or enter an allowed address.
translated: 目前的瀏覽器導覽規則封鎖了此位址。請選取其他分頁或輸入允許的位址。

text: Optional Discord-style guild/server ID constraint for binding evaluation in multi-server deployments. Use this when the same peer identifiers can appear across different guilds.
translated: 選用的 Discord 式社群／伺服器 ID 限制，用於多伺服器部署中的綁定評估。當相同的對端識別碼可能出現在不同社群時，請使用此設定。

text: Optional low-level agent runtime policy for this provider. Use provider/model runtime policy instead of agent-wide runtime pins; omitted/default lets OpenClaw choose the runtime for the selected provider.
translated: 此供應商的選用低階代理程式執行環境原則。請使用供應商／模型層級的執行環境原則，而非為整個代理程式固定執行環境；省略或使用預設值時，OpenClaw 會為所選供應商選擇執行環境。

text: As configured. A startup flag can override this.
translated: 依設定運作。啟動旗標可覆寫此設定。

text: Unsupported array schema. Use Raw mode.
translated: 不支援的陣列結構描述。 請使用原始模式。

text: Shared secret selected by gateway.auth.mode=password. Clients may send it in either auth.token or auth.password. Password mode is required for Tailscale Funnel.
translated: 由 gateway.auth.mode=password 選用的共用密鑰。用戶端可透過 auth.token 或 auth.password 傳送此密鑰。Tailscale Funnel 必須使用密碼模式。
連結理解的連結數量上限

text: There are more saved messages than we can show. Review or delete the copies below to make room. The remaining messages are still saved in this browser.
translated: 已儲存的訊息數量超過可顯示的上限。請檢視或刪除下方的副本以騰出空間。其餘訊息仍儲存在此瀏覽器中。

text: Some messages or long text are omitted to keep this public page within its size limit.
translated: 為使此公開頁面不超出大小限制，已省略部分訊息或較長的文字。

text: Per-agent model runtime id: "openclaw", "auto", a registered plugin harness id such as "codex", or a supported CLI backend alias such as "claude-cli".
translated: 個別代理的模型執行環境 ID："openclaw"、"auto"、已註冊的外掛程式執行框架 ID（例如 "codex"），或支援的 CLI 後端別名（例如 "claude-cli"）。

text: Default browser profile name selected when callers do not explicitly choose a profile. Use a stable low-privilege profile as the default to reduce accidental cross-context state use.
translated: 呼叫端未明確選擇設定檔時所使用的預設瀏覽器設定檔名稱。請使用穩定且權限較低的設定檔作為預設值，以減少意外跨情境使用狀態的情況。

text: Best for one-shot reminders that should auto-clean up.
translated: 最適合需要自動清除的一次性提醒。

text: Installs the available update on the connected Gateway and restarts it.
translated: 在已連線的 Gateway 上安裝可用更新，並重新啟動。

text: Always may require System Settings to approve background location.
translated: 選擇「永遠」可能需要在「系統設定」中核准背景位置存取權限。

text: Embedding model override used by the selected memory provider when a non-default model is required. Set this only when you need explicit recall quality/cost tuning beyond provider defaults.
translated: 需要非預設模型時，用來覆寫所選記憶供應商使用的嵌入模型。只有在需要超出供應商預設設定，明確調整檢索品質或成本時，才設定此項目。

text: The owner needs automation access to edit this automation. Transferring it pauses it and clears the previous owner’s saved access.
translated: 擁有者需要自動化存取權才能編輯此自動化。轉移自動化會暫停執行，並清除前一位擁有者已儲存的存取權。

text: Database engine selection. SQLite is the default; PostgreSQL is a supported alternative for the five configurable families. Doctor reports configured and observed engines and warns about mismatches, missing capabilities, or unavailable stores. See the PostgreSQL operator guide for platform and upgrade qualification limits.
translated: 選擇資料庫引擎。預設為 SQLite；五個可設定的類別也支援使用 PostgreSQL 作為替代方案。Doctor 會回報已設定和實際觀察到的引擎，並針對不相符、缺少功能或儲存區無法使用的情況提出警告。平台與升級的驗證限制，請參閱 PostgreSQL 操作指南。

text: Copy the draft below before clearing it and reloading.
translated: 清除草稿並重新載入前，請先複製下方的草稿。

text: A source opts in to capture when applied by the Gateway. Removing an entry stops its configured auto-start capture after the change takes effect; saved notes remain.
translated: Gateway 套用設定後，來源便會啟用記錄。移除項目後，該來源設定的自動啟動記錄會在變更生效後停止；已儲存的筆記會保留。

text: Gateway-wide default announce destination for automations that name no route of their own (no channel other than `last`, `to`, `threadId`, `accountId`, or owner targeting). It replaces the remembered session route at run time and never applies to `none` or `webhook` delivery. A `cron.creators.<profileId>.delivery` or `cron.agents.<agentId>.delivery` default wins over this one.
translated: 閘道全域的預設公告目的地，適用於未自行指定路由的自動化作業（未指定 `last` 以外的頻道、`to`、`threadId`、`accountId` 或擁有者目標）。執行時會取代已記住的工作階段路由，且不適用於 `none` 或 `webhook` 傳送方式。`cron.creators.<profileId>.delivery` 或 `cron.agents.<agentId>.delivery` 的預設設定優先於此設定。
啟用記憶搜尋多模態功能

text: Default pair loop protection settings for channel providers that support bot-to-bot loop guards. Use provider-specific overrides only when one channel needs a different budget.
translated: 適用於支援機器人間迴圈防護的頻道供應商之預設配對迴圈防護設定。僅在個別頻道需要不同額度時，才使用供應商專屬覆寫設定。

text: Client TLS certificate presented to the upstream endpoint when mutual TLS is required.
translated: 需要雙向 TLS 時，向上游端點提供的用戶端 TLS 憑證。

text: Optional group/channel session scope override for this route binding. "per-group" keeps matched rooms separate and ambiently watched by the agent main session regardless of dmScope; "main" merges their context into main and needs no watch.
translated: 此路由綁定的選用群組／頻道工作階段範圍覆寫設定。"per-group" 會將匹配的聊天室分開，並由代理程式的主要工作階段在背景持續監看，不受 dmScope 影響；"main" 則會將其上下文合併至主要工作階段，無須監看。

text: You need approval access to approve.
translated: 您需要核准權限才能核准。

translated: 核心工具，不含選用的外掛工具。
此技能將由團隊管理員管理。

text: Applies to sidebar deletes. Stopping cloud devices or removing saved worktrees always asks.
translated: 適用於側邊欄的刪除操作。停止雲端裝置或移除已儲存的工作樹時，一律會要求確認。
依序使用的備援影片生成模型（provider/model）。

text: Maximum number of hidden catalog search results a code-mode program can request.
translated: 程式碼模式程式可請求的隱藏目錄搜尋結果數量上限。

text: Pick an agent to inspect its workspace and tools.
translated: 選擇代理以檢視其工作區與工具。

text: Sets inactivity window before reset for idle mode and can also act as secondary guard with daily mode. Use larger values to preserve continuity or smaller values for fresher short-lived threads.
translated: 設定閒置模式下觸發重設前的無活動時長，也可在每日模式中作為額外的防護條件。使用較大的值可維持連續性，較小的值則適合更常更新的短期對話串。

text: Per-agent message action allowlist for the message tool. Set to a minimal list such as ["send"] for public sandbox agents so read, edit, delete, reaction, and other provider-specific message actions stay hidden and blocked.
translated: message 工具中各代理程式的訊息動作允許清單。針對公開沙箱代理程式，請設為最精簡的清單，例如 ["send"]，以便隱藏並封鎖讀取、編輯、刪除、表情回應及其他供應商專屬的訊息動作。

text: Optional bootstrap files that should not be created in agent workspaces. Valid values: SOUL.md, USER.md, IDENTITY.md (HEARTBEAT.md is accepted but a no-op).
translated: 不應在代理程式工作區中建立的選用初始化檔案。有效值：SOUL.md、USER.md、IDENTITY.md（接受 HEARTBEAT.md，但不會產生任何作用）。

text: Bundled Control UI icon name, such as server. An unknown name falls back to the provider's built-in brand or display-name initial.
translated: Control UI 內建圖示的名稱，例如 server。若名稱不明，則改用供應商的內建品牌圖示或顯示名稱的首字元。

text: Overnight issues, PRs, and CI failures, ranked by urgency.
translated: 依緊急程度排序的隔夜議題、提取要求及 CI 失敗。

translated: 請嘗試其他搜尋條件或選擇其他篩選條件。

text: Open a session where the agent looks for lessons worth saving as skills.
translated: 開啟工作階段，讓代理尋找值得儲存為技能的經驗。

text: Reconnect to view this item, or open the original.
translated: 請重新連線以查看此項目，或開啟原始內容。

text: Defines reset policy for group chat sessions where continuity and noise patterns differ from DMs. Use shorter idle windows for busy groups if context drift becomes a problem.
translated: 定義群組聊天工作階段的重設原則，其對話連貫性與雜訊模式和直接訊息不同。若上下文偏移成為問題，可為訊息頻繁的群組設定較短的閒置時限。

translated: 設定後，允許透過受信任的 Tailscale 身分途徑通過 Gateway 驗證檢查。僅在 tailnet 身分安全機制完善，且操作人員工作流程依賴此功能時使用。

text: Accept agent-visible plugin tool descriptors published by paired nodes (default: true). Set false to ignore and remove all node-published plugin tools.
translated: 接受由已配對節點發佈、對代理程式可見的外掛工具描述資訊（預設值：true）。設為 false 可忽略並移除所有由節點發佈的外掛工具。

translated: 若使用 pnpm ui:dev，請根據目前簽出的程式碼重新建置或重新啟動開發版 UI。

text: Use a local model service or set up a private GGUF model on the computer running OpenClaw.
translated: 請在執行 OpenClaw 的電腦上使用本機模型服務，或設定私人 GGUF 模型。

translated: 設為 true 時，會透過 Gateway HTTP 程序提供 Gateway Control UI。若要進行本機管理，請保持啟用；若已由外部控制介面取代，則可停用。

text: Companion apps for your phone, watch, desktop, and browser — plus plugins to extend what your agent can do.
translated: 適用於手機、手錶、桌面和瀏覽器的配套應用程式 — 還有外掛程式可擴充代理程式的功能。

text: The server was saved but is still disabled. Couldn’t enable it for this session. {error}
translated: 伺服器已儲存，但仍處於停用狀態。無法在此工作階段中啟用。{error}

translated: 無法確認工作階段是否已移動。請重新整理並檢查其所屬群組後再試一次。{error}

translated: 多帳號頻道設定中的選用帳號選擇器，適用於必須透過特定帳號情境路由外掛程式核准的情況。

translated: 正在儲存您的帳號。請等候結果。

text: Live config-reload policy for how edits are applied and when full restarts are triggered. Keep hybrid behavior for safest operational updates unless debugging reload internals.
translated: 即時重新載入設定的策略，決定如何套用編輯內容，以及何時觸發完整重新啟動。除非正在對重新載入的內部機制進行偵錯，否則請保留混合模式，以最安全的方式更新運作中的設定。

text: Investigate an issue in a sandbox
Write a prompt to start a session.
translated: 請輸入提示詞以開始工作階段。

translated: 此工作階段尚無儀表板小工具。

text: Controls citation visibility in replies: "auto" shows citations when useful, "on" always shows them, and "off" hides them. Keep "auto" for a balanced signal-to-noise default.
translated: 控制回覆中的引用顯示方式："auto" 在有幫助時顯示引用，"on" 一律顯示，"off" 則隱藏。保留 "auto" 可在資訊量與干擾之間取得平衡，作為預設設定。

translated: 這項尚未確認的變更屬於另一個 Gateway。請重新連線至該 Gateway 後重試，或捨棄草稿。

translated: 掛鉤對應項目的選用固定識別碼，用於稽核、疑難排解及針對性更新。請使用唯一 ID，讓日誌與設定差異能明確參照對應項目。
{done} 個已完成 · {failed} 個失敗或已停止

translated: 請暫時停止從此分頁重試。

translated: 防護式壓縮摘要的品質稽核重試設定。防護模式預設啟用此功能；設定 enabled: false 可略過摘要稽核與重新產生。

translated: 條件觸發器已停用。現有設定會保留，直到您將其清除。

Off by default; while off the Gateway starts no child process, opens no tunnel sockets, and contacts no OpenClaw ID, Discovery or relay service.

translated: 隨 OpenTelemetry 匯出請求傳送的額外 HTTP 請求標頭，通常用於租戶驗證或路由。請將機密資訊存放在由環境變數提供的值中，並避免加入不必要的標頭。

text: Adds custom HTTP headers to remote embedding requests, merged with provider defaults. Use this for proxy auth and tenant routing headers, and keep values minimal to avoid leaking sensitive metadata.
translated: 在遠端嵌入向量請求中加入自訂 HTTP 標頭，並與供應商預設值合併。可用於代理驗證及租戶路由標頭，並請將標頭值限制在必要的最少範圍，以免洩漏敏感中繼資料。

text: Named browser profile connection map used for explicit routing to CDP ports or URLs with optional metadata. Keep profile names consistent and avoid overlapping endpoint definitions.

text: Agent whose model and credentials own ambient system-agent and Custodian consults. Also used when models.list, models.authStatus, skills.status, doctor.memory.status, or an infer CLI command that resolves agent-owned model or auth state omits agentId or --agent; explicit request agentId always wins.
translated: 提供模型與憑證，供背景系統代理與 Custodian 諮詢使用的代理。當 models.list、models.authStatus、skills.status、doctor.memory.status，或用於解析代理所屬模型或驗證狀態的 infer CLI 命令未指定 agentId 或 --agent 時，也會使用此代理；請求中明確指定的 agentId 一律優先。

translated: 通用 OpenClaw 程式碼模式。若全域設定中省略此設定，則預設為 `"auto"`；若已明確設定物件但未包含 `enabled`，則維持停用。啟用此模式的代理執行只會向模型提供 `exec` 和 `wait`，並透過目錄橋接存取一般工具。

translated: 不需要或不支援豐富格式的負載呈現時，使用的純文字備用範本。可用於為聊天訊息傳送介面提供簡潔且一致的摘要字串。

translated: 無法將詳細模式變更為「{level}」。請選擇 off、on 或 full。

Set false to disable SSH verification (independent of autoApproveCidrs, which stays active); for manual-only pairing also unset autoApproveCidrs. Pass an object to override user/identity/timeoutMs/cidrs.

translated: 「主要」會將任務加入代理程式的時間軸。「獨立」會在獨立工作階段中啟動回覆。

translated: 代理程式會在執行允許清單未涵蓋的指令前先詢問。

translated: 目前沒有啟用的技能。請還原已封存的技能，或讓代理程式學習。

text: Device access for notifications, capture, voice, and personal data.
translated: 通知、擷取、語音及個人資料的裝置存取權限。

translated: 時間使用 Gateway 主機的時區，而非此瀏覽器的時區。此設定控制更新開始的時間；推出延遲、閒置檢查和倒數計時仍然適用。

translated: 正在啟動擷取。請重新整理健康狀態以查看結果。

text: Check the backup job logs and try again.

新增專屬的外掛程式頁面。

text: Shared default settings inherited by agents unless overridden per entry in agents.entries. Use defaults to enforce consistent baseline behavior and reduce duplicated per-agent configuration.
translated: 代理程式繼承的共用預設設定，除非在 agents.entries 的個別項目中覆寫。使用預設設定可確保一致的基本行為，並減少各代理程式的重複設定。

text: Set up Chrome on this device
Couldn’t save the agent identity. Reconnect and try again.
translated: 無法儲存代理程式身分。請重新連線後再試一次。

text: Clears this browser’s saved sign-in for {gateway} and signs this tab out, then reconnects. Other Gateways, your preferences, and this browser’s device identity stay. You may need to sign in or approve this browser again.
translated: 清除此瀏覽器為 {gateway} 儲存的登入資訊，將此分頁登出，然後重新連線。其他 Gateway、您的偏好設定及此瀏覽器的裝置身分都會保留。您可能需要重新登入或再次核准此瀏覽器。
無法完成此自動化作業：{error}

text: Fill in the required fields below to save.
translated: 請填寫下方必填欄位以儲存。

translated: 模型供應商請求驗證標頭名稱

text: Grant access in the OpenClaw Mac app on that device: Settings → This Mac → Permissions. Then tell the agent to try again.
translated: 請在該裝置上的 OpenClaw Mac app 中授予存取權限：設定 → 這部 Mac → 權限。然後請代理程式再試一次。

text: Save or discard your file edits before reloading.
translated: 請先儲存或捨棄檔案編輯，再重新載入。

text: Treat quoted bot messages as implicit mentions by default. Defaults to true for backward compatibility.
translated: 預設將引用機器人訊息視為隱含提及。為維持向後相容性，預設值為 true。

text: Set an upstream branch, then retry.
translated: 請設定上游分支，再重試。

text: Couldn’t insert the mention. Return to the message box and try again.
translated: 無法插入提及。請返回訊息輸入框再試一次。

text: Showing the first chunk of this page ({count} total lines).
translated: 目前顯示此頁面的第一部分 (共 {count} 行).
請重新連線以檢視外掛程式。
無法載入 {count} 個資源。請再試一次。

text: Asking the selected model for a quick reply…
translated: 正在請選取的模型簡短回覆…

text: Live view · Updates while this tab is visible
translated: 即時檢視 · 此分頁可見時持續更新

text: 95% of measured pings completed in this time or less.
translated: 95% 的延遲測量在此時間內完成。

text: Microphone input stopped. Choose an available input and start again.
translated: 麥克風輸入已停止。 請選擇可用的輸入裝置並重新開始。

text: Couldn’t restore the attached context. Edit this message to review and resend it without context.
translated: 無法還原附加的上下文。請編輯此訊息以檢查內容，然後在不附加上下文的情況下重新傳送。

text: Stop the foreground Gateway, run `openclaw update`, then launch it again. For automatic updates, install a managed Gateway service.
translated: 請停止前景執行的 Gateway，執行 `openclaw update`，然後再次啟動。若要自動更新，請安裝受管理的 Gateway 服務。

text: Check the portal address and your connection, then try again.
translated: 請檢查入口位址與您的連線，然後再試一次。

text: To make changes, update the configuration file or deployment settings for this Gateway.
translated: 若要進行變更，請更新此 Gateway 的設定檔或部署設定。

text: Couldn’t verify your identity. Device and setup tokens don’t identify a person.
translated: 無法驗證您的身分。裝置權杖和設定權杖無法識別個人身分。
目前使用的 Git 作者

text: Pin browser routing to a specific node id or name (optional).
translated: 將瀏覽器路由固定至特定節點 ID 或名稱（選填）。

text: Conversation changed while copying. Try again.
translated: 複製時對話已變更。請再試一次。
必須提供 Cron 運算式。

text: Global opt-in for experimental assistance from the owning agent’s configured Decision model (default: false; requires explicit true). The effective decisionModel can be inherited from global defaults or selected per agent; an empty per-agent value disables assistance. Supported uses may send selected data to that provider and incur provider charges. See the Decision assistance documentation for supported uses, setup, and data handling. This setting does not gate explicit decision_evaluate calls, select providers, or grant actions.
translated: 全域選擇啟用由所屬代理程式設定的 Decision 模型提供的實驗性輔助功能（預設值：false；必須明確設為 true）。實際生效的 decisionModel 可繼承自全域預設值，或針對各代理程式個別選取；若個別代理程式的值為空，則會停用輔助功能。支援的用途可能會將選定的資料傳送至該供應商，並產生供應商費用。請參閱 Decision 輔助功能文件，瞭解支援的用途、設定方式及資料處理方式。此設定不會限制明確的 decision_evaluate 呼叫、選取供應商或授予動作執行權限。

text: Couldn’t update PR info. It may be outdated.
translated: 無法更新 PR 資訊。資訊可能已過時。

text: Default timeout for video-understanding requests. Increase it for longer clips or slower local analysis models.
translated: 影片理解請求的預設逾時時間。處理較長的影片片段或使用較慢的本機分析模型時，請增加此時間。
使用代理程式的工作區

text: Open a change, file, image, or tool result to review it here.
translated: 開啟變更、檔案、圖片或工具結果，即可在此檢閱。

text: Ask your admin to review your access. Reconnect after they make changes.
translated: 請管理員檢查您的存取權限。管理員變更權限後，請重新連線。
操作員角色工作節點設定檔

text: Review the account details, then try again.
translated: 請檢查帳號詳細資料後再試一次。

text: Maximum concurrent nested tool calls a code-mode VM can start before it must resume later.
translated: 程式碼模式虛擬機器在必須暫停並稍後恢復之前，可同時啟動的巢狀工具呼叫數量上限。

text: Search settings apply to all agents. Choose an agent and model to see their effective route.
translated: 搜尋設定適用於所有代理程式。選擇代理程式和模型，即可查看實際使用的搜尋途徑。

text: Tools to keep directly visible instead of cataloging. Uses the same selectors as include; exclusion wins. Omitted or [] excludes nothing. Does not grant permissions or override direct-only and runtime-required tools.
translated: 保持直接可見、不編入目錄的工具。使用與 include 相同的選取器；排除條件優先。省略或設為 [] 時不排除任何工具。不會授予權限，也不會覆寫僅限直接呼叫或執行階段必要工具的設定。
啟用 CLI 代理程式
顯示全部 {count} 行未修改的內容

text: This draft already matches the live skill. Discard it.
translated: 此草稿已與現行技能相同，請將其捨棄。

text: This page includes conversation text, tool steps, shared images, and interactive widgets. Tool result text and reasoning are omitted.
translated: 此頁面包含對話文字、工具步驟、分享的圖片及互動式小工具。不包含工具結果文字及推理內容。

text: Realtime output cancellation was not accepted.
translated: 取消即時輸出的請求未獲接受。

text: More executions could not be loaded. Try again.
translated: 無法載入更多執行。請再試一次。

text: Delete this snapshot. This can’t be undone. Failed deletion stays pending for maintenance to retry.
translated: 刪除此快照。此操作無法復原。若刪除失敗，將維持待處理狀態，等待維護作業重試。

text: GitHub {kind} was observed. Disconnecting does not undo this effect.
translated: 已觀察到 GitHub {kind}. 中斷連線不會復原此效果。

text: Incognito sessions last for 24 hours or until the Gateway restarts. Your unsent input stays in this tab.
translated: 無痕工作階段會持續 24 小時，或直到 Gateway 重新啟動為止。您尚未傳送的輸入內容會保留在此分頁中。

text: This version is too different from today's to compare line by line.
translated: 此版本與目前版本差異過大，無法逐行比較。
無法搜尋訊息。請再試一次。

text: Global master switch for thread-bound session spawning, routing, and delivery. Disable to turn off thread binding globally.
translated: 討論串綁定工作階段建立、路由與傳遞的全域總開關。停用即可在全域關閉討論串綁定。
掛鉤對應代理程式 ID

text: Match requires a VNC server that supports desktop resizing.
translated: 配合視窗功能需要支援調整桌面大小的 VNC 伺服器。

text: The operation was approved for this request only.
translated: 此操作僅獲准用於本次請求。
觸發警示前的連續錯誤次數。

text: You need admin access to set up models.
translated: 您需要管理員權限才能設定模型。
在 Mac 應用程式中開啟

text: Leave blank to use the default timeout for this reply.
translated: 留空即可使用此回覆的預設逾時時間。
綁定工作階段群組範圍

text: Inbound webhook automation surface for mapping external events into wake or agent actions in OpenClaw. Keep this locked down with explicit token/session/agent controls before exposing it beyond trusted networks.
translated: 用於將外部事件對應至 OpenClaw 喚醒或代理程式動作的傳入 Webhook 自動化介面。在向信任網路以外開放此介面之前，請先透過明確的權杖、工作階段及代理程式控制措施，嚴格限制存取。

text: Authentication profile root used for multi-profile provider credentials and cooldown-based failover ordering. Keep profiles minimal and explicit so automatic failover behavior stays auditable.
translated: 驗證設定檔的根節點，用於管理多個設定檔的供應商憑證，以及依冷卻時間決定的容錯移轉順序。請讓設定檔保持精簡且明確，以便稽核自動容錯移轉行為。

text: Hostname patterns denied before DNS and allow rules on every web_fetch redirect. Supports exact hosts and "*.example.com" for subdomains only; add "example.com" separately to block the apex. Empty or unset adds no denials.
translated: 每次 web_fetch 重新導向時，會在 DNS 解析及允許規則之前先套用的主機名稱封鎖模式。支援完整主機名稱，以及僅比對子網域的 "*.example.com"；若要封鎖根網域，請另外加入 "example.com"。留空或未設定時，不會新增任何封鎖規則。

text: Allows this plugin to add or change the context and instructions sent to the model, which can influence its responses. Only allow this for plugins you trust.
translated: 允許此外掛程式新增或變更傳送給模型的上下文與指令，這可能會影響模型的回應。請僅對您信任的外掛程式授予此權限。

text: Couldn’t finish setup. Check the OpenClaw CLI on this device with openclaw browser extension setup, then try again.
translated: 無法完成設定。請在此裝置上使用 openclaw browser extension setup 檢查 OpenClaw CLI，然後再試一次。
佇列中的訊息仍暫緩傳送。

text: Applies to everyone on this Gateway.
translated: 適用於此 Gateway 上的所有人。

text: Couldn’t save trigger words. Try again.
translated: 無法儲存觸發詞。請再試一次。

text: No tools in this preview. More may become available before a reply.
translated: 此預覽中沒有工具。回覆前可能會有更多可用工具。
無法重新整理活動。正在重試…

text: Public HTTPS PNG, JPEG, WebP, or GIF URL without embedded credentials or a fragment. The Gateway fetches and sanitizes the image with private-network and redirect protections; the browser never contacts this URL directly.
translated: 公開的 HTTPS PNG、JPEG、WebP 或 GIF URL，不得包含內嵌憑證或片段識別碼。Gateway 會在具備私人網路與重新導向防護的情況下擷取圖片並進行安全處理；瀏覽器不會直接連線至此 URL。
第 {start}–{end} 則回覆，共 {total} 則
OpenAI Chat Completions 圖片限制

text: Controls post-compaction session memory reindex mode: "off", "async", or "await" (default: "async"). Use "await" for strongest freshness, "async" for lower compaction latency, and "off" only when session-memory sync is handled elsewhere.
translated: 控制壓縮後的工作階段記憶重新索引模式："off"、"async" 或 "await"（預設為 "async"）。使用 "await" 可最大程度確保資料即時更新，使用 "async" 可降低壓縮延遲；僅在其他機制已處理工作階段記憶同步時，才使用 "off"。

text: Diagnostics controls for targeted tracing, telemetry export, and cache inspection during debugging. Keep baseline diagnostics minimal in production and enable deeper signals only when investigating issues.
translated: 診斷控制項，用於偵錯期間的針對性追蹤、遙測匯出及快取檢查。在正式環境中，請將基本診斷維持在最低限度，僅在調查問題時啟用更深入的診斷訊號。

text: Per-channel debounce overrides for queue behavior keyed by channel ID, including plugin channels. Use this to tune burst handling independently for chat surfaces with different pacing.
translated: 以通道 ID 為索引鍵的各通道佇列防抖覆寫設定，包含外掛通道。可使用此設定，針對訊息節奏不同的聊天介面，個別調整突發訊息的處理方式。
檢視待傳送的輸入內容
記憶搜尋結果數量上限

text: No session slots are available. Wait for a slot or pick another device.
translated: 目前沒有可用的工作階段名額。請等待名額釋出，或選擇其他裝置。

text: Use filesystem acceleration for new managed worktrees when supported (default: true). Set false to use normal Git checkout and file copying. Applies only to new worktrees.
translated: 在支援的情況下，對新建的受管理工作樹使用檔案系統加速（預設值：true）。設為 false 可使用一般的 Git 簽出與檔案複製。僅適用於新建的工作樹。

text: This execution path does not provide {label} evidence.
translated: 此執行路徑不提供{label}的佐證。

text: Restrict filesystem tools (read/write/edit/apply_patch) to the workspace directory (default: false).
translated: 將檔案系統工具（read/write/edit/apply_patch）限制在工作區目錄內使用（預設值：false）。

text: Channel provider configurations plus shared defaults that control access policies and per-surface behavior. Keep defaults centralized and override per provider only where required.
translated: 通道供應商設定及共用預設值，用於控制存取原則與各介面的行為。請集中管理預設值，並僅在必要時針對個別供應商覆寫。

text: Destination identifier inside the selected channel when mapping replies should route to a fixed target. Verify provider-specific destination formats before enabling production mappings.
translated: 當映射回覆應傳送至固定目標時，所選頻道內的目的地識別碼。在正式環境中啟用映射前，請先確認各供應商專用的目的地格式。

text: Enter a macOS account allowed in System Settings → General → Sharing. Remote Management also requires Observe/Control permissions.
translated: 請輸入在 System Settings → General → Sharing 中允許存取的 macOS 帳號。Remote Management 也需要 Observe/Control 權限。
網路安全政策容錯移轉模式

text: Base URL for the provider endpoint used to serve model requests for that provider entry. Use HTTPS endpoints and keep URLs environment-specific through config templating where needed.
translated: 供應商端點的基底 URL，用於處理該供應商項目的模型請求。請使用 HTTPS 端點，並視需要透過設定範本，為不同環境指定各自的 URL。
Talk 即時前置音訊保留時間（毫秒）

text: Optional meeting URL for providers that join by URL instead of channel id. Use only trusted meeting links because auto-start may join and capture that meeting.
translated: 選填的會議 URL，適用於透過 URL 而非頻道 ID 加入會議的提供者。請僅使用可信任的會議連結，因為自動啟動可能會加入並擷取該會議的內容。

text: Couldn’t complete the notification request. Try again.
translated: 無法完成通知請求。請再試一次。
請重新連線以建立代理程式。

text: Event automations need an agent task in a separate or existing session.
translated: 事件自動化需要在獨立或現有的工作階段中執行代理程式任務。

text: Couldn’t apply the selected revision to this checkout. Review the update details.
translated: 無法將所選修訂版本套用至此簽出副本。請查看更新詳細資訊。
進階: 代理程式 GitHub 覆寫設定

text: Overrides the auto-discovered sqlite-vec extension library path (`.dylib`, `.so`, or `.dll`). Use this when your runtime cannot find sqlite-vec automatically or you pin a known-good build.
translated: 覆寫自動偵測到的 sqlite-vec 擴充程式庫路徑（`.dylib`、`.so` 或 `.dll`）。當執行環境無法自動找到 sqlite-vec，或您要固定使用已知可正常運作的建置版本時，請使用此設定。

text: Remote gateway over SSH (tunnels the gateway port to localhost). Format: user@host or user@host:port.
translated: 透過 SSH 連線的遠端閘道（將閘道連接埠透過通道轉送至 localhost）。格式：user@host 或 user@host:port。
無法匯入記憶。請再試一次。

text: Control UI updated. Reload this page to continue the terminal action.
translated: Control UI 已更新。 請重新載入此頁面以繼續終端機操作。

text: This file does not exist yet. Saving will create it in the agent workspace.
translated: 此檔案尚不存在。儲存時會在代理程式工作區中建立此檔案。

text: This Gateway does not offer audit.run.inspect. Upgrade the Gateway, enable execution identity collection, and record a new run.
translated: 此 Gateway 不提供 audit.run.inspect。請升級 Gateway、啟用執行身分收集，並記錄新的執行作業。

text: OpenClaw Code Mode for this agent and exact provider/model: On forces it on, Off disables it, and Default inherits the agent activation setting, then the shared model override, then tools.codeMode.enabled. This does not change the selected runtime or Codex native Code Mode.
translated: 此代理與指定供應商／模型的 OpenClaw 程式碼模式：開啟會強制啟用，關閉會停用，預設則依序繼承代理啟用設定、共用模型覆寫設定，最後是 tools.codeMode.enabled。這不會變更所選的執行環境或 Codex 原生程式碼模式。

text: Allows this plugin to add or change the context and instructions sent to the model, which can influence its responses. Only allow this for plugins you trust. Allowed by default. Set false to block prompt-modifying hooks, tool prompt guidance, next-turn prompt contributions, and active-run steering.
translated: 允許此外掛程式新增或變更傳送給模型的上下文與指令，這可能會影響模型的回應。請僅對您信任的外掛程式授予此權限。預設為允許。設為 false 可封鎖會修改提示詞的掛鉤、工具提示詞指引、下一輪的提示詞增補內容，以及對進行中執行作業的引導。

text: Channel/provider identifier this binding applies to, such as `telegram`, `discord`, or a plugin channel ID. Use the configured channel key exactly so binding evaluation works reliably.
translated: 此綁定適用的頻道／供應商識別碼，例如 `telegram`、`discord` 或外掛程式頻道 ID。請使用與設定完全一致的頻道鍵，以確保綁定判定可靠運作。

text: You and your agent share this isolated session browser
translated: 您與您的代理程式共用此隔離的工作階段瀏覽器

text: Matches a normalized session-key prefix after internal key normalization steps in policy consumers. Use this for general prefix controls, and prefer rawKeyPrefix when exact full-key matching is required.
translated: 在使用原則的元件完成內部鍵正規化步驟後，比對正規化的工作階段鍵前綴。一般前綴控制可使用此設定；若需要精確比對完整鍵，請優先使用 rawKeyPrefix。

text: Per-profile Chromium user data directory for existing-session attachment through Chrome DevTools MCP. Use this for Brave, Edge, Chromium, or non-default Chrome profiles when the built-in auto-connect path would pick the wrong browser data directory on the selected host or browser node. Paths starting with ~ expand to the OS home directory.
translated: 各設定檔的 Chromium 使用者資料目錄，用於透過 Chrome DevTools MCP 連接至現有工作階段。若內建的自動連線流程會在所選主機或瀏覽器節點上選到錯誤的瀏覽器資料目錄，可使用此設定指定 Brave、Edge、Chromium 或非預設 Chrome 設定檔的目錄。以 ~ 開頭的路徑會展開為作業系統的家目錄。

text: Your changes to {channel} aren’t saved. Discarding removes them.
translated: 您對 {channel} 的變更尚未儲存。捨棄後，這些變更將會移除。

text: Controls whether mapping execution results are delivered back to a channel destination versus being processed silently. Disable delivery for background automations that should not post user-facing output.
translated: 控制是否將對應執行結果傳回目標頻道，而非靜默處理。對於不應發布使用者可見輸出的背景自動化作業，請停用傳送。

text: The Gateway could not return this diagnostic projection. No identity facts were inferred from Live activity.
translated: Gateway 無法傳回此診斷投影。未從即時活動推斷任何身分資訊。

text: A repository identity is required to change its default cloud device.
translated: 需要儲存庫身分識別資訊才能變更其預設雲端裝置。
連線已中斷。此檢視會自動重新連線。

text: Stops unfinished personal publication. Published work stays intact; revoke the app grant separately in GitHub settings.
translated: 停止尚未完成的個人發佈。已發佈的成果保持不變; 請另行前往 GitHub 設定撤銷應用程式授權。
正在安裝外掛程式相依套件…

text: The provider stopped this session. Review its findings before starting more work.
translated: 供應商已停止此工作階段。請先檢視其檢查結果，再開始其他工作。

text: Sign in with a different account, or choose Connect after an admin grants access.
translated: 請使用其他帳戶登入，或在管理員授予存取權後選擇「連線」。

text: This Gateway URL uses plaintext ws://. Use wss:// or Tailscale Serve, then create a new code for full access.
translated: 此 Gateway URL 使用明文 ws://。請使用 wss:// 或 Tailscale Serve，然後建立新設定碼以取得完整存取權限。

text: Enables the operator terminal for admin-scope clients (default: true). This exposes a browser/mobile shell with the gateway process environment; set false to opt out on deployments where admin operators should not get a host shell. Changes apply without restarting the Gateway.
translated: 為具備管理員權限範圍的用戶端啟用操作員終端機（預設值：true）。這會提供使用 Gateway 程序環境的瀏覽器／行動裝置 shell；若部署環境不應讓管理員操作員取得主機 shell，請設為 false 以停用。變更無須重新啟動 Gateway 即可套用。

text: Compact large OpenClaw, MCP, and client tool catalogs. OpenClaw runtimes use structured Tool Search automatically when unset; engaged Code Mode takes precedence and Codex uses its native search. Set false to disable it, true for structured search, or use the object form to choose a mode.
translated: 精簡大型 OpenClaw、MCP 及用戶端工具目錄。未設定時，OpenClaw 執行環境會自動使用結構化工具搜尋；啟用的程式碼模式會優先使用，而 Codex 則使用其原生搜尋。設為 false 可停用，設為 true 可使用結構化搜尋，或使用物件形式選擇模式。

text: The processed avatar is larger than 512 KB.
translated: 處理後的頭像大於 512 KB.
正在載入執行檢查資訊…

text: One named operator role. Every definition must explicitly provide its session-sharing policy, allowed session and run agents, and operator-scope ceiling, and can require sandbox isolation for newly created sessions and a plugin access policy.
translated: 一個具名的操作員角色。每項定義都必須明確提供其工作階段分享政策、允許用於工作階段與執行的代理程式，以及操作員權限範圍上限，也可以要求新建立的工作階段採用沙箱隔離，並指定外掛程式存取政策。

translated: 無法重新開始代理程式的回覆。請再試一次。

text: Talk reasoning strategy: agent-consult for Gateway-mediated agent help, direct-tools for local tool calls, or none.
translated: Talk 推理策略：agent-consult 表示透過 Gateway 取得代理協助，direct-tools 表示呼叫本機工具，none 表示不使用。

text: Optional retention window in hours for persisted media handled by the general mtime sweep. Leave unset to disable that sweep, or set values like 24 (1 day) or 168 (7 days) to periodically remove older staged media. Managed outgoing media (chat-generated attachments) is excluded and follows its own SQLite- and transcript-aware retention.
translated: 由一般 mtime 清理作業處理的持久儲存媒體可選用的保留期限，以小時為單位。留空可停用該清理作業，或設為 24（1 天）、168（7 天）等數值，以定期移除較舊的暫存媒體。受管理的傳出媒體（聊天產生的附件）不在此範圍內，並遵循其專屬、會考量 SQLite 與對話記錄的保留機制。

text: Explicitly allows this plugin to request api.runtime.llm.complete against a non-default agent id. Keep false unless the plugin is trusted for cross-agent model access.
translated: 明確允許此外掛程式以非預設代理 ID 請求 api.runtime.llm.complete。除非信任此外掛程式可跨代理存取模型，否則請維持 false。

text: Signal-specific OTLP/HTTP logs endpoint. When set, this overrides diagnostics.otel.endpoint and OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT for log export only.
translated: 專用於日誌訊號的 OTLP/HTTP 端點。設定後，僅在匯出日誌時覆寫 diagnostics.otel.endpoint 和 OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT。

text: The connection changed before the group was saved. Try again.
translated: 儲存群組前，連線已變更。請再試一次。
自動化 Webhook SSRF 政策
指派給此代理的自動化作業。

text: Value for the Strict-Transport-Security response header. Set only on HTTPS origins that you fully control; use false to explicitly disable.
translated: Strict-Transport-Security 回應標頭的值。僅應在您完全控制的 HTTPS 來源上設定；使用 false 可明確停用。

text: Path published by Tailscale Serve/Funnel for Gmail callback forwarding when enabled. Keep it aligned with Gmail webhook config so requests reach the expected handler.
translated: 啟用後，由 Tailscale Serve/Funnel 發布、用於轉送 Gmail 回呼的路徑。請確保此路徑與 Gmail webhook 設定一致，讓請求能送達預期的處理常式。
捨棄本機副本並重新整理

text: Couldn’t rebuild the Control UI. Fix the UI build error and retry.
translated: 無法重新建置 Control UI。請修正 UI 建置錯誤後重試。
沒有符合搜尋條件的設定。

text: Moving requires a session-owned worktree or repository workspace.
translated: 移轉需要屬於此工作階段的工作樹或儲存庫工作區。

text: Max characters of each workspace bootstrap file injected into the system prompt before truncation (default: 20000).
translated: 每個工作區啟動檔案注入系統提示的字元數上限，超出部分將截斷（預設：20000）。

text: Creates branch {branch} in a separate checkout.
translated: 在獨立的簽出目錄中建立分支 {branch}。
目前顯示上次取得的資料。

text: The active reply will be interrupted. Partial output is not replayed on the destination.
translated: 目前進行中的回覆將中斷。已產生的部分輸出不會在目的地重播。

text: Enter a duration of at least 1m, such as 45m or 2h, or leave suspend after empty.
translated: 請輸入至少 1m 的時間長度，例如 45m 或 2h，或將暫停前的閒置時間欄位留空。
外掛程式相依套件已安裝

text: Couldn’t download this file. Try again. {error}
translated: 無法下載此檔案。請再試一次。{error}

text: The feature setting could not be saved.

OpenClaw Code Mode for this exact provider/model: On forces it on, Off disables it, and Default inherits tools.codeMode.enabled. Agent-specific activation settings take precedence. This does not change the selected runtime or Codex native Code Mode.
translated: 此特定供應商／模型的 OpenClaw 程式碼模式：開啟會強制啟用，關閉會停用，預設則沿用 tools.codeMode.enabled。代理程式專屬的啟用設定具有優先權。這不會變更所選的執行環境或 Codex 原生程式碼模式。

text: Local callback server settings block for directly receiving Gmail notifications without a separate ingress layer. Enable only when this process should terminate webhook traffic itself.
translated: 本機回呼伺服器設定區塊，用於直接接收 Gmail 通知，無需獨立的流量入口層。僅在此程序應自行處理 webhook 傳入流量時啟用。

text: Use lightweight bootstrap context for this agent job.
translated: 為此代理程式作業使用精簡的啟動上下文。

text: Update the Gateway to set up models.
translated: 請更新 Gateway 以設定模型。

text: Still waiting. If you already approved, the tab may have opened in another browser or profile. Try again from here.
translated: 仍在等待中。如果您已授權，分頁可能開在其他瀏覽器或使用者設定檔中。請從這裡再試一次。

text: Tool policy wrapper for spawned subagents to restrict or expand tool availability compared to parent defaults. Use this to keep delegated agent capabilities scoped to task intent.
translated: 針對衍生子代理程式的工具政策封裝，可在父代理程式預設值的基礎上限制或擴大工具可用範圍。使用此設定可將受委派代理程式的能力限制在任務所需範圍內。

text: Match rule object for deciding when a binding applies, including channel and optional account/peer constraints. Keep rules narrow to avoid accidental agent takeover across contexts.
translated: 用於判定何時套用綁定的比對規則物件，包含頻道及選用的帳號／對端限制條件。請縮小規則範圍，避免代理程式意外接管其他情境。

text: Enables text-command parsing in chat input in addition to native command surfaces where available. Keep this enabled for compatibility across channels that do not support native command registration.
translated: 除了可用的原生指令介面外，也啟用聊天輸入中的文字指令解析。請保持啟用，以相容於不支援原生指令註冊的各個頻道。

text: Default for initiating messages to other sessions: always permits, ask requires human approval before sending, and never blocks. Requested replies and authorized delegated-task communication keep their existing authority.
translated: 主動傳送訊息給其他工作階段的預設設定：always 表示允許，ask 表示傳送前需要人工核准，never 則表示封鎖。應要求傳送的回覆及已授權的委派任務通訊會保留其現有權限。

text: An additional workspace file included with this Template.
translated: 此範本隨附的額外工作區檔案。

text: Optional Codex MCP tool approval mode for this server: "auto", "prompt", or "approve". Use only for MCP servers you intentionally trust.
translated: 此伺服器的選填 Codex MCP 工具核准模式："auto"、"prompt" 或 "approve"。僅適用於您明確信任的 MCP 伺服器。

text: Dreaming uses one automation for all agents. These settings apply to every agent and are managed by the {plugin} plugin.
translated: 做夢功能會為所有代理程式使用同一項自動化作業。這些設定適用於每個代理程式，並由 {plugin} 外掛程式管理。

text: Connect with a personal profile to save a custom image.
translated: 請使用個人設定檔連線，以儲存自訂圖片。

text: Optional allowlist of plugin IDs; a non-empty list restricts loading, except for the selected memory plugin (including the default memory-core selection), equal-ID context-engine plugins, and explicitly enabled bundled chat channels. Differently named context-engine owners must be independently enabled or allowlisted and included in any non-empty allowlist. Plugin-owned tools outside the allowlist remain unavailable. Use plugins.deny or plugins.entries.<id>.enabled: false to block a plugin regardless of slot selection.
translated: 選用的外掛 ID 允許清單；非空清單會限制載入，但所選的記憶外掛（包括預設選項 memory-core）、ID 相同的 context-engine 外掛，以及明確啟用的內建聊天頻道除外。名稱不同的 context-engine 擁有者必須個別啟用或加入允許清單，且只要允許清單非空，就必須列於其中。不在允許清單中的外掛所提供的工具仍無法使用。若要封鎖外掛而不受插槽選擇影響，請使用 plugins.deny 或 plugins.entries.<id>.enabled: false。
正在開啟代理程式的主要工作階段…

text: Literal prefix for query embeddings. Used unless a non-empty queryInstruction is set; an empty string disables automatic query formatting.
translated: 用於查詢嵌入的原樣前綴。除非設定了非空的 queryInstruction，否則會使用此前綴；空字串會停用自動查詢格式設定。

text: Couldn’t check the update source. Try again.
translated: 無法檢查更新來源。請再試一次。

text: Domain allowlist for native Codex web_search. On native-hosted-search turns, it also gates managed web_fetch; managed-provider turns are unchanged.
translated: 原生 Codex web_search 的網域允許清單。在使用原生託管搜尋的回合中，此清單也會限制受管理的 web_fetch；使用受管理供應商的回合則不受影響。

text: Handles short background tasks such as generated titles, progress narration, and session summaries.
translated: 處理簡短的背景工作，例如產生標題、描述進度及摘要工作階段。
正在載入外掛程式詳細資訊…

text: OAuth credential ownership for this server. Omit this field or use "shared" for operator-managed credentials; use "per-requester" to let each authenticated sender connect their own account.
translated: 此伺服器的 OAuth 憑證歸屬。省略此欄位或使用 "shared"，即可使用由操作人員管理的憑證；使用 "per-requester" 則可讓每位已通過驗證的傳送者連結自己的帳戶。

text: Additional shared skill roots to scan at lowest precedence. Use this for sibling repos or shared skill packs that should be available without copying them into the OpenClaw workspace.
translated: 以最低優先順序掃描的額外共用技能根目錄。適用於同層儲存庫或共用技能套件，無須將其複製到 OpenClaw 工作區即可使用。

text: This connection has no personal profile; sign in through Cloudflare Access, Tailscale Serve, or a trusted proxy to set a name and avatar.
translated: 此連線沒有個人檔案；請透過 Cloudflare Access、Tailscale Serve 或受信任的代理伺服器登入，以設定名稱和頭像。

text: Device {nodeVersion}; Gateway {gatewayVersion}. Update the older version to match.
translated: 裝置版本為 {nodeVersion}；Gateway 版本為 {gatewayVersion}。請更新較舊的版本，使兩者一致。
尚未設定 MCP 伺服器。

text: Explicit gateway-level tool allowlist when you want a narrow set of tools available at runtime. Use this for locked-down environments where tool scope must be tightly controlled.
translated: 明確指定的 Gateway 層級工具允許清單，適用於只希望在執行階段提供少量工具的情況。請用於必須嚴格控管工具範圍的受限環境。

text: Conversation identifier used with peer matching, such as a chat ID, channel ID, or group ID from the provider. Keep this exact to avoid silent non-matches.
translated: 用於對端比對的對話識別碼，例如供應商提供的聊天 ID、頻道 ID 或群組 ID。請確保此值完全正確，以免比對失敗卻未收到提示。

text: Controls whether this plugin may read raw conversation content from typed hooks such as `before_agent_run`, `before_model_resolve`, `before_agent_reply`, `llm_input`, `llm_output`, `before_agent_finalize`, and `agent_end`. Non-bundled plugins must opt in explicitly.
translated: 控制此外掛程式是否可透過 `before_agent_run`、`before_model_resolve`、`before_agent_reply`、`llm_input`、`llm_output`、`before_agent_finalize` 和 `agent_end` 等具型別掛鉤讀取原始對話內容。非隨附的外掛程式必須明確選擇啟用。

text: Saved copies of this conversation from rewinds or repairs. You can return to an earlier version here.
translated: 此對話在回溯或修復時儲存的副本。您可以在這裡返回較早的版本。

text: Enable embedded proactive auto-compaction (default: true). Set false to stop threshold-driven embedded compaction while preserving OpenClaw overflow recovery, preflight compaction, and manual /compact.
translated: 啟用內嵌的主動自動壓縮（預設：true）。設為 false 可停止由閾值觸發的內嵌壓縮，同時保留 OpenClaw 溢位復原、預檢壓縮及手動 /compact 功能。
允許外掛程式覆寫 LLM 代理

text: Manage all settings, including the raw config.
translated: 管理所有設定，包括原始設定檔。
已收到 · 等待工作區同步

text: Use the stored secret name, for example SEARCH_API_KEY.
translated: 使用已儲存的機密名稱，例如 SEARCH_API_KEY。

text: Passphrase used to encrypt this location. Prefer a SecretRef and keep a recoverable copy: losing or changing the passphrase makes existing encrypted objects unreadable.
translated: 用於加密此位置的通關密語。建議使用 SecretRef，並保留可復原的副本：遺失或變更通關密語將導致現有的加密物件無法讀取。

text: Top-level binding rules for routing and persistent ACP conversation ownership. Use type=route for normal routing and type=acp for persistent ACP harness bindings.
translated: 用於路由與持久性 ACP 對話歸屬的頂層綁定規則。一般路由請使用 type=route，持久性 ACP 執行框架綁定請使用 type=acp。

text: Couldn’t show all checks. Open the original to see them.
translated: 無法顯示所有檢查項目。請開啟原始內容查看。

text: Autocorrect is unavailable in browser control. Edit the text directly.
translated: 瀏覽器控制功能不支援自動校正。請直接編輯文字。

text: Preferred image resize side for balanced compression. Leave unset to use OpenClaw's conservative default.
translated: 調整圖片大小時偏好的邊長，以平衡壓縮效果。若不設定，則使用 OpenClaw 的保守預設值。

text: Choose views for this browser window. Built-in views are always available.
translated: 選擇此瀏覽器視窗要使用的檢視。內建檢視一律可用。
工具允許清單新增項目

text: Choose which coding apps show their sessions in the sidebar.
translated: 選擇要在側邊欄顯示工作階段的程式開發應用程式。

text: ACP backend override for this binding (falls back to agent runtime ACP backend, then global acp.backend).
translated: 此綁定的 ACP 後端覆寫設定（未設定時使用代理執行環境的 ACP 後端，再未設定則使用全域 acp.backend）。
舊版設定路由; 開啟外觀設定。

text: Target size after disk-budget cleanup (high-water mark). Defaults to 80% of maxDiskBytes; set explicitly for tighter reclaim behavior on constrained disks. A value that resolves to zero falls back to the default; negative values are invalid. Disable the budget with maxDiskBytes instead.
translated: 磁碟預算清理後的目標大小（高水位標記）。預設為 maxDiskBytes 的 80%；若磁碟空間有限，可明確設定此值，以更嚴格地回收空間。解析結果為零時會回復為預設值；負值無效。如要停用預算限制，請改用 maxDiskBytes。

text: Enables durable automatic meeting notes, the transcripts agent tool, and configured auto-start sources. Default: true. Set false to disable persistence and the tool; explicit meeting transcribe mode retains its bounded live tail.
translated: 啟用可持久儲存的自動會議筆記、transcripts 代理工具，以及已設定的自動啟動來源。預設值：true。設為 false 可停用持久儲存與工具；明確指定的會議轉錄模式仍會保留有限範圍的最新即時內容。

text: Optional provider-specific `input_type` value for query-time memory embeddings. Use this with OpenAI-compatible asymmetric embedding endpoints that require a query label.
translated: 用於查詢時記憶嵌入的選填 `input_type` 值，依供應商而定。適用於需要查詢標籤且相容於 OpenAI 的非對稱嵌入端點。

text: No active capture subscription is reported for this transcript.
translated: 目前未回報此逐字稿有任何啟用中的擷取訂閱。

text: Active work in this session stops. Other sessions aren’t archived.
translated: 此工作階段中進行中的工作將停止。其他工作階段不會被封存。

text: View and control this Mac from Systems. Enabled by default. Requires Screen Sharing in macOS System Settings → General → Sharing. Changes briefly reconnect this Mac; a new capability may need pairing approval.
translated: 從「系統」檢視並控制這部 Mac。預設啟用。需要在 macOS「系統設定」→「一般」→「共享」中啟用「螢幕共享」。變更設定會讓這部 Mac 短暫重新連線；新功能可能需要配對核准。

text: Pairing link is no longer valid
A connected extension does not mean eligible tabs are available. Check tabs on this device and browser profile in the browser tools; an empty list is different from a disconnected extension.
translated: 擴充功能已連線不代表有符合條件的分頁可用。請在瀏覽器工具中檢查此裝置與瀏覽器設定檔的分頁；分頁清單為空與擴充功能未連線是不同的狀況。

text: This section changed. Reopen it before saving your edits.
translated: 此區段已變更。請重新開啟後再儲存編輯內容。

text: Use this section to publish skills installed in ~/.openclaw/skills from the headless node host. Restart the node host after changing skill files.
translated: 使用此區段，從無介面節點主機發布安裝於 ~/.openclaw/skills 的技能。變更技能檔案後，請重新啟動節點主機。

text: Update OpenClaw to test provider access.
translated: 請更新 OpenClaw 以測試供應商存取權限。

text: The installation was saved. Resolve the reported issue before reloading the plugin; do not install it again.
translated: 安裝已儲存。請先解決回報的問題，再重新載入外掛程式；請勿再次安裝。
沒有符合搜尋條件的訊息。

text: Primary accent color used by UI surfaces for emphasis, badges, and visual identity cues. Use high-contrast values that remain readable across light/dark themes.
translated: UI 介面用於強調、徽章及視覺識別提示的主要強調色。請使用在淺色與深色佈景主題中都能保持清晰易讀的高對比色值。

text: {count} settings in this config can only be edited as text: {paths}
translated: 此設定中有 {count} 個設定項目只能以文字編輯: {paths}
已新增 {provider}。{model} 已準備好，可以開始聊天。

text: Sign-in saves an account for this person on this Gateway. Shared and agent accounts stay unchanged.
translated: 登入後，系統會在此 Gateway 上為此使用者儲存帳號。共用帳號和代理程式帳號維持不變。

text: Run this command in a local checkout to mirror this session’s committed changes.
translated: 在本機簽出目錄中執行此命令，以同步此工作階段已提交的變更。

text: Total user and agent messages in this range.
translated: 此範圍內使用者與代理程式的訊息總數。

translated: 與你的代理進行連續語音對話。

text: OpenClaw is an open-source AI assistant that runs on your own computer and meets you in the channels you already use: Discord, iMessage, Slack, Teams, Telegram, WhatsApp, and 20+ more. State, memory, and credentials stay on your hardware, and models are plugins you can swap without changing anything else. No paid tier, no hosted service, no token: MIT-licensed and stewarded by the independent OpenClaw Foundation.
translated: OpenClaw 是一款開源 AI 助理，在你自己的電腦上執行，並透過你慣用的管道與你互動：Discord、iMessage、Slack、Teams、Telegram、WhatsApp，以及其他 20 多種管道。狀態、記憶與憑證都保留在你的硬體上，而模型則以外掛形式提供，可隨時替換，無須變更其他設定。沒有付費方案、不提供託管服務，也沒有代幣：採用 MIT 授權，由獨立的 OpenClaw Foundation 維護管理。

translated: 各設定檔用於 existing-session 連接的額外 Chrome DevTools MCP 引數，例如 --no-usage-statistics。此處的端點引數會覆寫內建的自動連線或瀏覽器 URL 選擇。

translated: 預期的證據遺失、損毀、非預期到期或無法讀取。

translated: 所有代理程式與儲存庫中現存的受管理工作樹數量上限（預設值：4096）。會優先移除已合併或壓縮合併的分支，再移除閒置時間最久的工作樹，包括其中未儲存的資料。執行中的工作會受到保護；若其數量已達上限，請提高此值。磁碟空間准入限制仍然適用。

translated: 用於裝置節點上 Talk 語音辨識及 iOS 系統語音備援的 BCP 47 地區設定識別碼，例如 "ru-RU"。留空可使用各裝置的預設值。

translated: 啟用防護式壓縮的摘要品質稽核與重新產生重試。預設值：防護模式下為 true。

text: Authorize GitHub without pasting a long-lived credential into the browser.
translated: 授權 GitHub, 無需將長效憑證貼入瀏覽器。

translated: 這份已儲存的副本在您檢視期間發生了變更。未刪除任何內容。請重新載入並再次檢視。
